levels.surface: حميد بن عبد، الرحمن بن عوف

notes: «قال قرأت على مالك» is a transmission verb: مالك is the link; «حميد بن عبد، الرحمن بن عوف» keeps the comma written in the text
the Companion Muawiya is the last link: he speaks the Prophet's words inside his own speech on the pulpit; the crowd's address is not a link
